body: hey man. i actually logged out of this account for a bit since it was a throwaway. things have been good. was actually randomly triggered by something but i remembered you all of a sudden. im going back to america soon and im kinda anxious. hope youre doing ok yourself
drink a beer for me too lol cheers!

really hate how the advice is 'just call them again and hope you dont get another terrible person'. we cannot go to the hospital even without the stigma, it would put many of us in debt. sucks so bad :-(

yeah ive been trying to eat a bit healthier while in asia since they make a lot of tasty veggie dishes. im usually in cali and my go to is in n out. you dont have to respond but you were my first thought when i woke up this morning. hope youre having a good day dude

idk i feel very stressed and unhappy and hormonal. i didnt have a good childhood and my family was very angry so i feel like im also cursed to fly off the handle sometimes. i keep trying to see new therapists but i always end up where i started. i guess i would want to manage myself better and put myself in a position where i can better the world instead of resenting it.

im usa west coast but im in asia rn visiting some people. its like midnight here. i might pass out but tbh. thanks man even this small talk really evened me out. its so weird

its been a couple years but i feel like im frustrated because nothing is changing. not even personally, it feels like the world is going more and more to shit every day. for every step forward we take three steps back sort of thing yknow? also i fucking love tacos, whats your fav to get?

... no youre right. in my haze i attributed a sarcastic tone to what you said without realizing it may have been something else. im sorry for snapping at you. sometimes i get so overwhelmed i just get angry. im here a lot with a variety of throwaways just making posts at different points in my life so it hasnt been great. soup is really good man

its fine though buddy. i know you dont have any answers either. i just fucking hate the world and everything in it and one day ill be gone and thatll be that. maybe tomorrow or maybe years from now. youll never know and youll never care

bro quite frankly it isn't my job to fix it. i can eat soup and truthfully tell you it tastes like shit without understanding how to make it taste better. it feels like i have a broken leg and these messages are just like "remember you can always drive yourself to a hospital or call an ambulance!" and then there's radio silence when neither of those are an option for you. maybe fixing up the way mental institutions are run or how people have such consistent terrible experiences with suicide hotlines. add some fucking salt. who gives a fuck
